verdict.rationale: A community indexing tip says Elasticsearch's default refresh interval is 1 second, which implies newly indexed documents become searchable within about a second. The semantic_text docs show content is embedded at index time with no separate pipeline, so documents are indexed incrementally rather than through a batch reindex. missing for 10: first-party documentation of near-real-time search and refresh semantics, explicit evidence that updates and deletes become visible in near real time, and confirmation that no full reindex is needed for those changes.
